verdict.rationale: Morph serves open-weight models such as Kimi K3 through OpenAI-compatible and native Anthropic Messages endpoints. Its docs describe moving production agents off Anthropic/OpenAI onto Kimi K3 and running Claude Code against Morph. Both workflows depend on tool calling, which implies function-calling support, but no page explicitly documents tool-call schemas or fidelity. Missing for 10: explicit function/tool-calling documentation, parallel tool-call support, multi-step tool-use guarantees or benchmarks, independent hands-on corroboration of tool-call reliability on open models.
